concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a round RADISH PUP, the first stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, sitting low on four short stubby legs, leaning forward, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 round radish head-body with face; 2 three leaves on top; 3 two front legs; 4 two hind feet; 5 radish root tail;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 round radish head-body with face: a round chubby radish: deep crimson-red skin on the top, back and sides, a big warm cream patch on the front holding the face and belly; two big dark-brown eyes (one small catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a confident open grin with a small fang where the old mouth is.
2 three leaves on top: three sturdy radish leaves of dark forest green with an olive midrib and slightly wavy edges, the same sizes and directions as the old leaves.
3 two front legs: two short stubby front legs in deep crimson red with cream toe tips, the same shape and place.
4 two hind feet: two short stubby feet in deep crimson red with cream toe pads.
5 radish root tail: a thin tapering radish root tail in deep crimson red with a cream tip, curving out like the old tail; not a leaf.

ATTITUDE: a tough little radish ready to charge: brows angled down, a confident open grin with a small fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: deep crimson-red radish skin, a warm cream face-and-belly patch, dark forest-green leaves with olive midribs, big dark-brown eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: pale washed-out green, a pale green or whitish body, pink flowers or petals, purple bells, a human face or human hair, glowing dots, sparkles, a light-green sprout body, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
